_comment: Explicit, ordered study set of CVE IDs (committed for reproducibility). 18 headline CVEs + 3 deliberately lower-profile/obscure CVEs (CVE-2019-2725 WebLogic, CVE-2018-7600 Drupalgeddon2, CVE-2022-22954 VMware SSTI) to test whether poisoning bites harder where the model has weak memorized priors. See DECISIONS.md: headline CVEs bias AGAINST the steering effect, so measured steering is a conservative floor. The first two back config/settings.test.yaml. config.ingestion.max_cves caps how many are used.
